title: Month-end payroll accrual for days worked but not yet paid
prompt: Calculate the month-end payroll accrual for days worked but not yet paid, and prepare the reversing entry.

setup.q: What is the pay calendar (frequency, pay dates, the lag between period end and pay date)?

inputs.name: Payroll register for the last pay run before period end

steps: from the pay calendar find the last pay period paid before period end and count the working days from its end to the period end
take gross wages, employer taxes and benefits from the register totals; daily cost equals the register total divided by the working days in its pay period
accrual equals daily cost times the unpaid working days, by department where the register totals allow; show the arithmetic
read the period-lock state; propose the accrual dated the period end and the reversal dated the first day of the next period (tier B), the reversal summary naming the accrual it reverses
write the workbook with totals only

done.text: The accrual and its reversal balance to the penny
The accrual is proposed once and no existing payroll accrual for the period is duplicated
Every exception row cites the register total line and the calendar date it rests on
payroll-accrual.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The unpaid days come from the calendar, the daily cost from the register totals, and both are shown; the deliverable carries totals only, with no employee name or pay

tierRules.when: the accrual dated the period end and its reversal dated the first day of the next period
